name: Threat Pings
description: See what you hear. Combat sounds around you - pearls thrown, bows and crossbows fired, potions splashed, gapples eaten, totems popped, shields broken, crystals and anchors exploding - show up as colored pings on a ring around your crosshair, pointing to where they came from, with distance and an above/below marker. Only sounds you could already hear are shown.
